summary: Tested the KI-Trader Dynamik-Werkbank changes against the live app. Backend: the 21 required unit tests in test_workbench_dynamic_1206.py pass. I added 11 API regression tests (all pass) and 3 tests for the ArrayLRU memory cap and importing core/config without dotenv (all pass). I ran ONE real cloud match run (wb_7bf34112de, about 2.5 min, named TEST_match_run). During the run /active showed comparison rows, a second start returned 409, and the run ended 'done' and appears in /history and /run. UI: all listed flows were checked and work: 4 tabs, the analysis-select suitability tag, the advice verdict with its reasons toggle, the timeframe hint whose apply button sets the select to 15m, the tf-variation checkbox (checked by default on discover), candidate chips and the 'alle' button, the mode select hidden on match, the asset suggestion block, the history table and opening a run (switches to the match tab), comparison expand, 'kein Edge' coins, and the result-elsewhere hint and button. No page errors. Problems found are business logic in the match ranking and API defaults, not crashes.

critical.issue: The overfitting protection picks a consistently losing strategy as the phase winner. candidate_rank puts 'overfit' before score, so a strategy that loses in training AND test beats a strategy that is profitable in training and loses less in test but is flagged overfit. Run wb_7bf34112de, regime 2: winner rsi_only (train -70.9, test -48.3, score -56.7) over bollinger_reversion (train +43.35, test -21.17, score 48.3, overfit). In stored run wb_c512e147db, macd_rsi_momentum (train -280.6) was also ranked above bollinger. The Regime breakdown then itself recommends 'besser mit Bollinger Mean Reversion'.

minor.issue: p = {k: body.get(k)} stores None for omitted keys, so p.get('walkforward', True), p.get('result_backtest', True) and p.get('skip_losing', True) all become None (off). An API-started run without these keys silently skips the final Holdout walk-forward and the result backtest (wb_7bf34112de: walkforward=null). The UI always sends them, so only API clients are affected.

When stage 2 improves nothing (log 'Runde 1 fertig · 0 Regime verbessert'), a new dynamic strategy is still built (dyn_c882d0dd) and the UI says 'neue dynamische Strategie angelegt'. There is no no_improvement guard like the one kind=refine has.
The note says 'keine Strategie mit Gewinn in diesem Regime' only because the chosen winner has pnl<=0, even though another candidate made +43.35 in training. It should check all candidates.

When the comparison winner is adopted, the entry has only score/pnl/trades: no test_pnl/test_trades/coins (coin_report=False). Result rows show '–' for Test and Coins (e.g. regime 3 'Leichter Aufwärtstrend' in wb_c512e147db, although its comparison row has test 3 trades / +24.96). When it is not adopted, the row shows the winner name with all metrics '–'.
regime_ids with non-numeric values make int() raise, so the endpoint returns 500 instead of 400.

Race window: 'if key in self._cache: return self._cache[key]', and multi-key sets followed by return self._cache[key], can raise KeyError if another thread (asyncio.to_thread jobs running in parallel) evicts the entry in between. Use a single get() / keep a local reference to the computed array.

integration_issues.issue: Switching to the run's tab does not preselect the run's analysis in dwb-analysis-select; it stays '– wählen –'.

issues: Stray small '00' text under the Zeitraum select ('gesamt') when no analysis is selected

With only 'bedingt' or 'ungeeignet' analyses and none selected, dwb-analysis-advice renders empty (no rec buttons, no warning). Expected with the current data, but there is no hint that no recommended detection exists.

action_items: Rework candidate_rank / match winner selection so 'not overfit' never ranks a strategy that is negative in train and test above a better one. E.g. apply the overfit/trade penalties only between candidates with positive test or train PnL, or rank by test PnL inside the same robustness tier.
Make edge_note check all comparison candidates, not just the winner.
In start, default walkforward/result_backtest/skip_losing to True when they are missing (do not store None).
For kind=match with no improvement, do not build a new identical dynamic strategy (same no_improvement guard as refine), or label the result clearly.
Copy test_pnl/test_trades (and coins if available) into the regime entry from compare_stage.
Harden the FastSeries cache lookups against concurrent eviction.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/dynamic.py (888 lines) and services/dynamic_workbench.py (844 lines) are over the 700-line guideline.
array_lru._evict runs list(OrderedDict.keys(cache))[-MIN_KEEP:] on every eviction step. This is O(n) per eviction and fine for now, but can get expensive with large caches.
ArrayLRU does not override pop/__delitem__/clear. If future code uses them, the global byte bookkeeping drifts.

success_rate.backend: 100% of tests pass (35/35); 1 high-priority logic issue plus minor issues
success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed UI flows work; minor UX items

Two match runs exist: wb_c512e147db (with walkforward) and wb_7bf34112de (walkforward null because the API body omitted walkforward). Run tests with: cd /app/ki-trader/backend && python3 -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -n0 tests/test_dwb_api_iter_match.py tests/test_workbench_dynamic_1206.py. A cloud match run takes about 2.5-4 min.
rca of the issue: Match winner: candidate_rank tuple = (robust, trade_sufficient, not overfit, dd_pass, score). regime_outliers flags overfit when the walk-forward is much weaker than training. A strategy that loses in both has no 'gap', so it is never overfit and wins the tier above any profitable-but-gappy candidate. Walkforward null: routers/dynamic.py builds p via body.get(k), which stores None, and dynamic_workbench uses p.get('walkforward', True), which returns that None.
